senses.gloss: m. (גְּנַן; cmp. חִנָּם fr. חָנַן) grace, undeserved gift; (adv. with or without prepos.) for nothing, in vain.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 15:27">Targ. Prov. XV, 27</cite>.—
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 20:7">Targ. Ex. XX, 7</cite>; <cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 5:11">Targ. Deut. V, 11</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bikkurim 3:3:14">Y. Bicc. III, 65ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>לא מ׳ מאריך ימים</he> it is not for nothing that he has been allowed a long life.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 85a:20">B. Kam. 85ᵃ</cite> <he>אסיא דמ׳</he> a physician (that will cure thee) without pay; <he>אסיא דמ׳ כמ׳ שוי</he> Ms. M. a. oth. (ed. incorr., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) a physician without pay is worth as much as unpaid service can be expected to be, i.e. an unpaid physician is likely to be careless.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 10:2:20">Y. Snh. X, 29ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>אפי׳ על מ׳</he> even if the curse has been pronounced gratuitously (without cause), cmp. <he>קללת חנם</he> s. v. <cite ref="H01307"><he>חִנָּם</he></cite>.
